proposalStatus: PROPOSED — metadata and identity research only; no source is frozen or finally accepted.

scope.selectionRule: All selected entries pass current corpus geometry, historical-identity disjointness, source-poster, current Commons SHA-1 plus 2 MiB prefix SHA-256 pin, and licence-review-gate evidence. This remains a proposal, not a frozen manifest.

methods.commonsImageinfo: Official Commons action=query imageinfo response for each supplied pageid, requesting url, size, mime, sha1, metadata, extmetadata, duration, and iiurlwidth=1280 thumbnail URL.
methods.posterInspection: Each official Commons imageinfo thumbnail URL was read directly as a source poster image. No neural/model output was inspected.
methods.posterScope: Each observation is intentionally limited to one poster image; it never asserts complete-video overlay, letterbox, or scene facts.
methods.identityPins: For clips admitted to proposal.json, SHA-256 was calculated only over HTTP bytes 0-2097151 from the current Commons source URL. No full video was downloaded.
methods.identityDisjointness: Compared creator, creator aliases, Commons uploader as separate provenance, derived shootId, source URL without query, case-folded title, pageid, Commons SHA-1, and any existing source SHA-256 values against the required historical manifests.
methods.licenseReviewGate: For every candidate, raw Commons wikitext was checked for LicenseReview/reviewer templates. Any candidate with a different uploader and credited author, or an upstream third-party platform/source URL, required a passed human LicenseReview record by a trusted reviewer under Commons:License review. An own-work declaration where the credited author and uploader match needs no such review. Automated YouTubeReview alone is not treated as a passed human review.
methods.reviewerTrust: Commons:License review was read. For manual records, the audit records reviewer and date from the raw template and separately records the available role evidence and any historical-role limitation.
methods.candidateSwap: Melting an iron nail (pageid 141943000) was initially researched as an own-work upload but was dropped before finalization because its own-work Source declaration coexists with a description stating the clip is derived from a larger linked YouTube video; that linked video ownership was not independently established. It was replaced with 2024 Sonnenaufgang Pfuhler See (pageid 175308771), an own-work daylight aerial clip with no linked third-party video, discovered via Category:Video display resolution 3840 x 2160 -> Category:Drone videos from Germany.

reservedValidationCreatorResult: Neither reserved validation identity appears in any supplied candidate creator or source-evidenced alias.

unresolvedIssues.detail: Current Commons imageinfo SHA-1 4104e276b9c2f399f656d064c6b7a88a300559bc conflicts with M196447532 P4092 checksum fb54df7070f4f9aea1743a96dc5f2adfc00dd859; the imageinfo history response did not reconcile it. Candidate is rejected.

The raw pages carry signed LicenseReview templates by INeverCry with dates. The current Commons API does not prove that reviewer’s exact group membership on those historical dates; later Commons logs show sysop/image-reviewer roles. Pageid 47838940 is separately rejected for historical identity collision. Pageid 48353914 remains proposed based on its recorded manual review, with the caveat preserved.

The raw Commons page declares Source own and associates the uploader with a credited author. It labels its YouTube link a cross-upload. The ownership of that linked platform record was not independently established, so this audit does not infer it.
Commons video metadata reports 1000 fps. It is recorded verbatim and was not independently decoded.

Commons marks these sources Public domain and their DVIDS records mark them PUBLIC DOMAIN, while DVIDS separately publishes privacy/publicity, trademark, and non-endorsement notices. All are rejected by the licence-review gate, so no selected clip depends on resolving this.
Every overlay, letterbox, scene, category, and capture observation is limited to one official Commons poster image. No complete-video fact is inferred from any poster.

licenseReviewPolicy.observed: Commons:License review says uploads sourced from external websites require review, and manual reviews are performed by Image Reviewers or administrators. This proposal uses that policy as a hard gate for third-party imports and uploader/author mismatches.
